description: This file contains implementation of functions interfacing with Metal shader library and kernel functions for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) in PyTorch, including creation, deletion, setup, dispatch, and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_tensor(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle handle,unsigned idx,AtenTensorHandle tensor)
methods.description: Sets a tensor argument for a Metal kernel function handle, converting the handle and tensor to internal representations and invoking setArg.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_int(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle handle,unsigned idx,int64_t val)
methods.description: Sets an integer argument for a Metal kernel function handle.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_create_shader_library(const char * metal_shader_source,AOTIMetalShaderLibraryHandle * library_handle)
methods.description: Creates a new Metal shader library from source code string.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_delete_shader_library(AOTIMetalShaderLibraryHandle library_handle)
methods.description: Deletes the specified Metal shader library.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_get_kernel_function(AOTIMetalShaderLibraryHandle library_handle,const char * kernel_name,AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle * function_handle)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached kernel function pointer from a shader library by name.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_start_encoding(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func)
methods.description: Begins encoding commands for a kernel function.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_single(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,uint64_t length)
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel function with a specified length.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_single_with_group_size(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,uint64_t length,uint64_t group_size)
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel function with a specified length and group size.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_array(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,const uint64_t * length,size_t length_size)
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel function with array arguments for lengths.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_array_with_group_size(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,const uint64_t * length,size_t length_size,const uint64_t * group_size,size_t group_size_size)
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel function with arrays for lengths and group sizes.

methods.name: void aoti_torch_mps_shared_callback(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,void * user_data)
methods.description: Shared callback function for std::function trampoline, invokes user-provided callback.

methods.name: AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_run_command_block(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,aoti_torch_mps_command_block_callback_t callback,void * user_data)
methods.description: Executes a command block with a callback, supporting a trampoline pattern for command execution.

ctags.name: aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_array_with_group_size
ctags.signature: (AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func,const uint64_t * length,size_t length_size,const uint64_t * group_size,size_t group_size_size)
